name: node-addon-api
description: C++ wrapper for Node-API (napi.h, napi-inl.h, napi-inl.deprecated.h) for an engine that embeds this repository's Node.js, installed as an overlay because the registry port is written for addons loaded by node.exe.

Why an overlay exists: the registry port depends on node-api-headers, whose include/node_api.h is a different header from the Node.js 26.13.1 tree this port builds, and whose lib/node.lib is an import library for the node executable an embedding engine does not have; its supports expression also excludes arm64 Windows, while the node port supports it. This copy depends on the node port, so <node_api.h> resolves to the header of the runtime the engine links, installs the three wrapper headers, exports the same unofficial::node-addon-api::node-addon-api target, and supports the same six cells. The version matches the registry at the pin.
